This '''battleship''' was part of the [[Sith invasion fleet]] during the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] and was under the command during the [[Battle of Koros Major (Great Hyperspace War)|Battle of Koros Major]]. [[Gav Daragon]] fled the battle in this ship, and went to [[Primus Goluud/Legends|Primus Goluud]].
